title: Stage-band alumni communicate with students
summary: Nearly everyone in the band came out of high school stage bands, helping them talk with students at clinics.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Becoming a teacher: jazz in schools and conservatories

blocks.x: So then, even in the activity of your clinics, your musicians in the last decade are enabled to do a better job in helping --

Well, and they're going to be asked questions. The youth now are -- for one thing, there's a good communication line there, because practically every guy in our band, in this current group, for instance, has been in a stage band in a high school at some point in his life.
They went through that same experience.
That's right. And I think that's an important factor in getting a lot of points across and a lot of ideas across.
